description: A typed function clause whose param annotation resolves to a STRUCT type (e.g. 'fn handle(x :: Box.t)' where Box.t = %Box{...}) does not dispatch -- it crashes at runtime: 'fz_struct_get_field_ref: ExpectedTag { expected: Struct, found: List }' (runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:1620), 'panic in a function that cannot unwind'. Repro: define a struct with @type t, a 'fn f(x :: list)/f(x :: Struct.t)' pair, call on a value typed list|Struct. The Region::Type arm over a struct type emits a struct-field access against the non-struct branch value. Struct PATTERNS ('%Box{v: v}') dispatch correctly, so the workaround is to use struct-shape arms; this ticket is the underlying Region::Type-over-struct codegen/runtime bug. Surfaced while building fz-bin (protocol dispatch); fz-bin sidesteps it by using struct patterns for struct impls.
title: [BUG] Region::Type dispatch over a struct type panics at runtime
